_planNotes.angle: Angle 3 — 'more games isn't enough' (Topic 6, the parent who believes volume of play is development). Mechanism = games MEASURE the athlete training built, they don't BUILD one. 'A game is a test, not a teacher.' Proof = the Athlete Analysis baseline + the 'one dad' case study + credentials + the guarantee — no forced RCT.
_planNotes.copyRule: BY REFERENCE, VERBATIM. Role-slot cards (A1–A4, B1–B2, C1–C2, D1–D2, E3 claim, E4) bind copy by id via copyRefs/hookRef. verbatimGuard CLEAN on ALL 17 now: E1/E2/F1 multi-field values were corrected to verbatim text (E1 quote = single magnet, E2 statsLabel = 'Built, then measured.', F1 title1+title2 concatenate to the verbatim promise line exactly). E3's claim_line binds the verbatim magnet 'Coach Graham Wilkerson built this.'; its coach name / CSCS / NFL-name slots are byline (attribution/identity, exempt) and carry verbatim names — cluster-31's proof_hero+proof_names roles were set to byline (a name list is attribution, not a message claim).
_planNotes.kicker: EXERCISED. B1 renders the full eyebrow→kicker→headline→subhead stack from three consecutive verbatim sentences (AD1 para1: 'More playing time feels like the answer.' / 'Another season, another team, more reps in real games.' / 'And a year later, the same kid, the same speed.'). D1 renders eyebrow→kicker→headline ('Games matter.' lead-in → the blame-removal sentence). A3 stays a 2-segment hook (headline+subhead) — its alt-hook has no third part. Casting three distinct complete verbatim lines into the three slots is selection, not stitching.
_planNotes.layout: eyebrow (INDIANAPOLIS SPORT PARENTS, white chip) → kicker → headline → subhead. cluster-43 is the stacked template (A3 hookRef 2-seg; B1 3-line kicker stack; D1 kicker+headline). Distinct skeleton within every beat.
_planNotes.media: EVERY creative media-backed. Statics set asset.media (./assets/mg-<id>.jpg); motion sets asset.clip (brand/video-templates/assets/mg-<id>.mp4). 17 DISTINCT cache clips, favoring 'where it's built' strength/power footage. Minted via scripts/prep-media.mjs (prefix mg-).

angles.name: More Games Isn't Enough (volume of play as development) — ad copy series #3
angles.mechanism: Games measure the athlete training built; they don't build one. A game is a test, not a teacher — it reveals what's already there, it doesn't add to it. Speed and power get built on purpose in training, or not at all.
angles.emotionalJob: Reframe games as a mirror, not a maker — without criticizing the parent's choices (validate the instinct, then flip it).
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative, metric-driven. No emoji / exclamation / em dash.
